atoms.statement: Add a local `freshWork` predicate near the existing `commit_famine` trigger.
atoms.test: Add focused unit coverage for fresh dirty work not firing and stale dirty work still firing, specifically verifying the behavior of the `freshWork` predicate.

atoms.statement: Add a freshness exemption to `commit_famine` using `last_commit_age_min < 5` minutes.
atoms.test: Verify fresh dirty task with `last_commit_age_min = 1` does not produce `commit_famine`; stale dirty task with `last_commit_age_min = 30` still does. (A.minimal_version) Also, thorough unit and smoke testing with both fresh-task and stuck-task scenarios, specifically for `last_commit_age_min < 5` exemption. (C.risks.4)

atoms.statement: Also exempt tasks with recent `progress_fingerprint` or `last_seq` change if freshness is derivable without new fields.
atoms.test: Add boundary tests for `<5`, `=5`, and stale progress for `progress_fingerprint` or `last_seq` (A.advanced_version). Thorough unit and smoke testing with both fresh-task and stuck-task scenarios, specifically for `progress_fingerprint` or `last_seq` freshness. (C.risks.4)

atoms.statement: Leave all existing hard famine requirements intact: dirty work, no live agent, not paused.
atoms.test: Verify with critic review of the final boolean expression to confirm legitimate dirty/no-progress famine remains detectable, and that existing `liveAgentRunning` and `paused` checks are preserved. (A.advanced_version, C.risks.4)

atoms.statement: Add focused unit coverage for fresh dirty work not firing and stale dirty work still firing.
atoms.test: Add or update focused tests: fresh dirty task with `last_commit_age_min = 1` does not produce `commit_famine`; stale dirty task with `last_commit_age_min = 30` still does. (A.minimal_version)

atoms.statement: Key the exemption on `last_seq_age_min` (progress freshness), NOT on `last_commit_age_min`.
atoms.test: Smoke-run `auditor-tick / Test-AuditorTriggers` against the live repo and inspect the `last_seq_age_min` values logged in the Detail string to confirm its behavior. (B.risks.4)

atoms.statement: Fire famine only when progress is stalled: add `-and [int]$c.last_seq_age_min -ge $freshProgressMin` (e.g., 10 min) to the existing condition.
atoms.test: Add one new scenario with `last_seq_age_min=2` asserting `commit_famine` is suppressed. (B.minimal_version)

atoms.statement: Do NOT exempt a spinning task; guard the exemption with `progress_fingerprint_repeats < 3` so famine remains a backstop for loops.
atoms.test: Verify spinning backstop: a task with `last_seq_age_min=1` (fresh) but `progress_fingerprint_repeats=4` still triggers `commit_famine`. (B.advanced_version)

atoms.statement: Update `tools/test-doctor-commit-famine-skip.ps1` to use stale `last_seq_age_min` for stuck scenarios and add fresh-seq + spinning scenarios.
atoms.test: Run the full test file and assert pass count increased with zero failures before/after, specifically checking scenarios 2/3/6/7 for expected `fires` behavior after updating `New-CommitFamineSnapshot`'s default `last_seq_age_min` to 45 (stale). (B.risks.3, B.minimal_version)

atoms.statement: Extend the `commit_famine` Detail string to include `last_seq_age_min` and `progress_fingerprint_repeats`.
atoms.test: Smoke-run `auditor-tick / Test-AuditorTriggers` against the live repo and inspect the Detail string for the presence and correctness of `last_seq_age_min` and `progress_fingerprint_repeats` values. (B.risks.4)

atoms.statement: Implement the change only in `lib/auditor.ps1` within `Get-AuditorSnapshot`.
atoms.test: Verify with `ParseFile` and a smoke run to ensure no other files are modified and the change is localized to `lib/auditor.ps1`. (A.minimal_version, B.minimal_version)
